_note: Verdicts corrected after the final gate, when an adversarial review (5 Nov 2026) found that the re-read traduora batch counted the app bar as rendered on screens whose NoAuthGuard keeps its *ngIf false; the first batch and its gate had held the stricter rule, that a condition must be satisfiable while the user stays on s, not only in a transition away from it. Each correction was checked against the source by hand.

ever-traduora extra /forgot-password /pr.reason: The app bar is behind *ngIf=isAuthenticated$ (app.component.html:3) and /forgot-password carries NoAuthGuard, so it is not shown there; the page's only link is /login (line 29) and its action only sets a status message.

ever-traduora extra /forgot-password /us.reason: As for /forgot-password -> /projects: the app bar is not shown under NoAuthGuard, and nothing else on the page reaches /user-settings.

ever-traduora extra /login /user-setting.reason: Not through the app bar, which NoAuthGuard hides on /login: AuthGuard on /user-settings dispatches MustLogin with the address, and a successful login on /login dispatches Navigate([redirect]) (auth.state.ts:258-262).
